Once a sacred tree, the only remnant of these that remain in the world are their wildroots. From these a skilled wild mage, with the correct words and ingredients, can invoke the ritual of Wildroot Growth.
A rare, treasured young of a tree that does not itself bear children. No longer born, almost all of them have been secreted away by the druids of old.

Unlike the leaves of other trees, the sacred wildwood has no longer the strength to bear saplings. Instead, the kernel of life common to all parts of the wildwood - the wildroot - may be found tucked amongst its leaves and its branches.
